theme.designMd:
# Portfolio Scrollytelling Design System

Polished, professional dark UI. Calm reveals, restrained motion, content first.
Carries over the current site look: slate background, emerald accent.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Background | #0F172A (slate-900) |
| Background deep | #020617 (slate-950) |
| Surface / card | #1E293B (slate-800) |
| Border | #334155 (slate-700) |
| Text | #F1F5F9 |
| Muted text | #CBD5E1 |
| Accent (emerald) | #34D399 -> #059669 gradient, used for highlighted words and the active progress dot |

## Typography
Inter. H1 56px/1.2, H2 32px/1.3, body 18px/1.6, labels 12px uppercase tracking-wide. Highlighted words (`<b>`) use the emerald gradient.

## Shape and spacing
Radius 12px. 8px spacing grid. Thin 1px borders, soft shadows, no glows.

## Layout and motion
- Desktop: two columns. Text steps scroll on the left, the visual stays pinned on the right (sticky, 100svh).
- Mobile: stacked, no pinning, visual sits inline above each step.
- Slim progress rail on the right edge: one dot per chapter, active dot is emerald, labels on hover. Becomes a top progress bar on mobile.
- Starfield particles stay as the fixed backdrop.
- Motion: fades and small translates under 0.5s; inactive steps at 25% opacity. All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chapters
1. Hello: name, role, tagline.
2. Person: hobbies (video games, camping, kayaking) and mentoring. Photos on the sticky panel.
3. Career: pinned timeline. Each step swaps the sticky card (company, role, period, stack).
4. Skills + AI: steps through Frontend, Backend, Cloud and DevOps, Testing, then "How I work with AI". Sticky panel shows tech logos, then an AI workflow diagram.
5. Contact: links and CV downloads.

screens.prompt:
Desktop pinned narrative scrollytelling chapter: '04 Skills + AI'.
Adhere strictly to the Dark mode theme with Slate dark background (#0f172a / #020617) and Emerald (#34D399) glowing accents.

Page layout & structure:
1. TopNavBar: sticky/fixed at top with brand logo 'Portfolio', navigation links ('Hello', 'Person', 'Career', 'Skills + AI' active with emerald underline, 'Contact'), and 'Resume' action button.
2. SideNavBar / Progress Rail: fixed on right side with 5 steps ('01 Hello', '02 Person', '03 Career', '04 Skills + AI' active with glowing emerald indicator, '05 Contact').
3. Chapter Header:
   - Section tracker pill: 'CHAPTER 04 / 05 — CAPABILITIES & ACCELERATION'
   - Large bold title: 'Engineered Craft meets AI Acceleration'
   - Subtitle explaining the shift from raw implementation to high-velocity system architecture and AI-augmented execution.

4. Two-Column Narrative Scrollytelling Section:
   - Left Column (Scrollable Narrative Milestones & Steps):
     * Step 1: 'Frontend Engineering' — Focus on high-fidelity interfaces, performance, micro-interactions, Tailwind, React/Next.js, TypeScript, state architectures.
     * Step 2: 'Backend & Systems Architecture' — Distributed services, Node/Python/Go, GraphQL & REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, event streaming.
     * Step 3: 'Cloud & DevOps' — Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, AWS/GCP serverless, Terraform, zero-downtime deploys.
     * Step 4: 'Testing, Quality & Reliability' — End-to-end testing with Playwright/Cypress, Jest/Vitest unit testing, observability, synthetic monitoring, SOC2 compliance.
     * Step 5 (Final Highlighted Step with glowing emerald border & special badge): 'How I Work With AI' — A dedicated narrative breakdown showing how AI expands leverage: rapid prototyping, autonomous agents, prompt architecture, and rigorous human-in-the-loop validation.

   - Right Column (Sticky Pinned Panel):
     * A persistent sticky card (top-28) framed with subtle glassmorphism (slate-900/90, border-slate-800, emerald glow shadows).
     * Interactive/segmented view displaying:
       - Tech Grid Tiles: Clean card tiles with sleek icons/badges for core tools (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Tailwind, GraphQL, Vitest, Git).
       - Workflow Diagram for 'How I Work With AI':
         A horizontal connected pipeline flow:
         1. [Idea] (Domain synthesis, user problem framing, architectural constraints)
         2. [AI Pair] (Rapid scaffolding, code generation, synthetic test synthesis)
         3. [Review] (Deep human verification, security scrutiny, edge-case testing, design precision)
         4. [Ship] (Automated CI/CD, canary deploy, telemetry & production monitoring)
         With clean arrows/connectors, status badges, and an explanatory telemetry callout box highlighting '3x shipping velocity, zero quality compromise'.

5. Footer component docked at the bottom with copyright and social links.
Ensure exquisite typography, badges, mono fonts for tech tags, and a sophisticated developer aesthetic.
screens.title: Skills + AI Narrative Chapter

outputComponents.text:
I have crafted the **"Skills + AI"** pinned narrative scrollytelling chapter (`Skills + AI Narrative Chapter`), consistent with your slate and emerald design system:

### Key Highlights:
1. **Two-Column Scrollytelling Architecture**:
   - **Left Narrative Steps**: Detailed milestone cards covering **Frontend Engineering**, **Backend & Systems Architecture**, **Cloud & DevOps**, **Testing, Quality & Reliability**, and an accented final showcase card for **"How I Work With AI"** featuring callouts on Zero-Friction Scaffolding, Human-in-the-Loop Review, Synthetic Edge Cases, and Continuous Velocity.
   - **Right Sticky Preview Panel**: Pinned terminal-inspired interface (`skills_and_workflow.sys`) showcasing:
     - **Core Stack & Tooling Matrix**: Crisp, categorized tech tiles with clear monospaced roles (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Tailwind, GraphQL, Vitest, Git).
     - **Continuous AI Pipeline Architecture**: A 4-phase sequential workflow diagram mapping **Idea** → **AI Pair** → **Review** → **Ship**, coupled with a live telemetry benchmark callout.
2. **Navigation & Progress Rail**:
   - Fixed header with active state under **Skills + AI**.
   - Floating right-hand progress rail with the **fourth indicator dot active**.
   - Consistent footer docking the page.

outputComponents.suggestion: Add interactive tab toggling between individual tech categories in the sticky panel
Add code preview snippets showing human-in-the-loop review examples
